title: Season 1
overview: Kamala Khan navigates high school and unlocking cosmic hard-light abilities.

episodes.title: Generation Why
episodes.overview: Kamala attends AvengerCon and unlocks light-harnessing powers with a mysterious bangle.

episodes.title: Crushed
episodes.overview: Kamala trains with Bruno and learns about her family heritage.

episodes.title: Destined
episodes.overview: Kamala meets the Clandestines and discovers their plan to use the bangle.

episodes.title: Seeing Red
episodes.overview: Kamala travels to Karachi to visit her grandmother and meets the Red Daggers.

episodes.title: Time and Again
episodes.overview: Kamala is transported through time to the 1947 Partition of India.

episodes.title: No Normal
episodes.overview: Kamala adopts the Ms. Marvel mantle and defends her friends from the Department of Damage Control.
